response: Therapeutic anticoagulation in trauma patients is associated with a significant complication rate, and it remains unclear which patients will develop complications. Currently, there is no clear answer on whether it is safe or not, as prospective studies are needed to determine the appropriate treatment regimen for this high-risk population. In other words, the safety of therapeutic anticoagulation in trauma patients has not been established, and more research is required to find a safe and effective approach.
